items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: Davey Jones was in there after you or before you? ... Oh, he must have got in there after us.

ctx.x: Davey Jones was in there after you or before you?

Oh, he must have got in there after us. Yeah, after us. You see, because after I left Rene, I went playing with some other fellas there, some little scrap band they had. I don't remember what band it was. Then right after I left, that's where Beansy was running the place, when he cut them down, they went to playing percentage, you see, and that's where Rene left, you see. Then Remy had a band, he used to come up there, you see. Is that T-Boy? T-Boy Remy. He used to come up there and play it too. He used to use…
